title: CIS Controls (IG1) maturity
heading:
How well do you cover the
CIS Controls?
lead: Eight quick questions across the core CIS Controls safeguards (Implementation Group 1) show how well you cover the basics that stop the most common attacks.

items.name: Asset inventory
items.q: Do you have an accurate inventory of your devices and hardware?
opts: A maintained inventory covering most assets.
A complete, actively maintained inventory, including unauthorised device detection.

items.name: Software inventory
items.q: Do you know what software is installed and allowed to run?
opts: A rough idea for key systems.
Full inventory with unsupported and unauthorised software removed.

items.name: Secure configuration
items.q: Are systems configured securely rather than left on defaults?
opts: Consistent secure baselines across the estate.
Enforced baselines to a recognised benchmark, with drift detection.

items.name: Account management
items.q: Are user and service accounts properly managed?
opts: Accounts rarely reviewed, dormant ones remain.
Full lifecycle management with prompt disablement of leavers.

items.name: Access control
items.q: Is access granted on a least-privilege basis with MFA?
opts: Role-based access with MFA on important systems.
Least privilege everywhere with strong MFA and reviews.

items.name: Vulnerability management
items.q: Do you find and fix vulnerabilities continuously?
opts: Continuous scanning with prioritised, tracked remediation.

items.name: Malware defences
items.q: How are devices protected against malware?
opts: Centrally managed protection across the fleet.
Modern EDR with monitoring and automated response.

items.name: Data recovery
items.q: Can you recover data reliably after an incident?
opts: Tested recovery with an offline or immutable copy.
